library.title: Library
library.description: Every Quake II installation the launcher knows about.

install.title: Install
install.description: Download, update and repair Quake II game files.

config.title: Config
config.description: Edit r1q2 settings and cvars without touching a .cfg file.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: Install and switch between game mods.

planned.title: {{module}} is not built yet
planned.body: This module has its place in the launcher reserved. Nothing here works yet – the shell, the installation list and the launch path are what ship first.

capability.long-running-jobs: Long-running jobs with progress and cancel
capability.cvar-schema: Contribute a cvar schema to the config UI

error.duplicate: That folder is already in your library as “{{name}}”.
error.notQuake2: {{path}} does not look like a Quake II installation. It needs a baseq2 folder or a known Quake II client.
error.notFound: That installation is no longer in your library.
error.createFailed: The folder {{path}} could not be created. Check that you have permission to write there.
error.alreadyContainsGame: {{path}} already contains a Quake II installation. Use “Add existing installation” instead.
error.deleteFromDiskUnsupported: Deleting game files is not implemented yet. The installation was left untouched.

toast.removed: Removed “{{name}}” from the launcher. The files are still on disk.

validation.title: Checks
validation.baseDirMissing: No {{dir}} folder – the game files are missing.
validation.pak0Missing: pak0.pak is missing from baseq2. Quake II cannot start without it.
validation.pak0MissingButPaksPresent: pak0.pak is missing, but other pak files are present. This may be a repacked or remastered install.
validation.pak0NotRetail: pak0.pak is not the size of the retail file. This is probably the shareware demo or a repacked copy – some maps and assets will be missing.
validation.retailPaksMissing: pak1.pak and pak2.pak are missing – this looks like the shareware demo rather than the full game.
validation.noExecutable: No client executable found in this folder.
validation.notWritable: {{path}} is not writable. Configs and save games cannot be stored there.
validation.engineUnknown: The Quake II client could not be identified.

note.r1q2: r1q2 has no separate user folder – it writes config.cfg, saves and screenshots straight into the installation. The folder has to be writable, so avoid Program Files.
note.remaster: The 2023 remaster is a different engine with its own game API, config location and network protocol. The launcher can start it, but it cannot join r1q2 servers and the config module will target r1q2 first.

hero.title: Ready when you are.
hero.body: Pick an installation on the left and hit play. Configuration, downloads, mods and asset packs land in the modules above as they get built.

empty.title: No Quake II installations yet
empty.body: Point the launcher at a folder you already have, let it search this PC, or set up a fresh installation folder.
empty.hint: A valid installation is a folder containing baseq2 with pak0.pak in it.

addExisting.title: Add existing installation
addExisting.body: Choose the folder that contains baseq2 – not baseq2 itself.
addExisting.executableHint: Several clients were found. Pick the one you want to launch.

detect.title: Search this PC
detect.body: Checks Steam, GOG and Epic plus the usual Quake II locations. Fast, and it never touches your files.
detect.deepBody: A deep scan walks your drives looking for a baseq2 folder. It is much slower, but finds installations in unusual places.
detect.none: Nothing found. Add the folder manually instead.

create.title: Create new installation
create.body: Creates an empty installation folder and registers it. Downloading the game files is the install module's job – that part is not built yet.
create.pickTitle: Choose where to create the installation
create.notice: After creating it, the installation will show “game files missing” until the install module can download them. You can also copy pak0.pak in by hand.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.body: This removes the installation from the launcher only. Nothing on your disk is touched.
remove.pathNote: The folder {{path}} stays exactly as it is.

empty.title: No config profiles yet
empty.body: Config profiles hold a set of cvars and key binds you can reuse across installations.
empty.hint: Use “New profile” to create one, empty or from the standard template.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.body: This deletes the profile from the launcher. It is not tied to any installation's files on disk, but it cannot be undone – once deleted, its cvars and binds are gone.

error.installationNotFound: That installation is no longer in your library.
error.profileNotFound: That config profile no longer exists.
error.notAssigned: This profile is not assigned to that installation.
